title: R' Dosa son of R' Chanina

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesikta deRav Kahana, 133, but Hyman says the reading should be R' Yose son of R' Chanina.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The replacement Yose for Dosa is Hyman’s proposed reading. The locator 133 is retained without asserting a particular printed edition’s pagination.

Dosa to Yose is Hyman’s proposed correction, retaining should be rather than silently replacing the heading. All four personal titles are abbreviated and retained as R'. Chanina in the body expands the initial ח contextually from the heading; familiarity with an amora is not rank evidence. Locator133 is retained without verifying a Buber page or another edition.
